arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
transliteration: Allahumma fa-ayyumaa mu'minin sababtuhu faj'al thaalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyaamah.
translation: O Allah, whomever of the believers I have insulted, let that be a cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.
